page.overview:
Who is Angela?

Angela was a Human female who lived on the planet of Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Angela lived in Coronet City with her husband Ilyamo.

In 1 ABY, Ilyamo and Angela went to Doaba Guerfel because Ilyamo wanted to go hiking. Ilyamo joined a group who went hiking in the Thaos Mountains with the ranger Myron Beech. However, the group suddenly disappeared. Desperate, she begged a spacer, sent by Commander Talte of the Corellian Security Force, to find him. an anti-government and criminal group. The CorSec eventually assaulted the cave where the hostages were kept and freed the hostages, including Ilyamo.

Some time later, Angela highly recommended the spacer who rescued her husband to her friend Madison Silene after her husband Kyran also disappeared.
